title: MarkerNodeCoordinate
author: JG
description: add option addReferenceCoordinates=False to include reference value in coordinate
releaseNotes: MarkerNodeCoordinate and MarkerNodeODE1Coordinate have includeReferenceCoordinate (default False): the marker gives the coordinate including its reference value, e.g. an absolute position; CreateCoordinateConstraint has includeReferenceCoordinates=[False, False] (revision2026c step RG11.8.2)
